name: Navigation Back Action Vector Icon
description: Standard left-pointing directional arrow icon used in top app bar for screen dismissal and backward stack navigation.
behavior_summary: Scalable SVG vector icon asset conforming to Material 24dp bounding box with crisp rendering across high-DPI displays.

reusability_assessment.notes: Standard standard-compliant vector icon, directly adaptable into fos_design_system icon pack.

name: Material Alert Dialog Layout Framework
description: Composite modal dialog component supporting title, message body, custom view injection, and positive/negative/neutral actions.
behavior_summary: Manages modal alert presentations, keyboard focus trapping, touch-outside dismissal, and responsive action button wrapping.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adaptable into Flutter FosAlertDialog with Family OS design tokens.

name: Local Messages SQLite Master Store
description: High-throughput local persistence store for message history, media metadata, read/unread states, and transmission queues.
behavior_summary: Operates under Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode to permit concurrent read queries during intensive background message batch ingestion.

reusability_assessment.notes: Cleanroom adaptation into Drift (SQLite) tables for Family OS local messaging storage (S1-08).

name: Multi-DC Connections Manager & Protocol Cascade
description: Resilient client network engine managing connections to distributed data centers with automated transport fallback.
behavior_summary: Attempts fast direct TCP sockets on standard and alternate ports; falls back to HTTP proxying and Secure WebSockets upon firewall blockage.

reusability_assessment.notes: Informs the architectural design of Family OS realtime gateway client in Flutter (S1-01 / S1-08).

name: Cloud PTS Sequence & Gap Resolution Engine
description: State synchronization algorithm ensuring message ordering, deduplication, and gap recovery across offline intervals.
behavior_summary: Maintains persistent PTS monotonic sequence numbers; upon sequence discontinuity, pauses ingestion and requests difference payload.

reusability_assessment.notes: Direct mathematical model adaptable for Family OS multi-device synchronization engine (S1-01 / S1-08).

name: Continuous Notification Foreground Service
description: Android foreground service ensuring reliable socket connectivity, push delivery, and incoming message alert dispatching.
behavior_summary: Keeps client networking active in background, binding notification manager channels and managing system power-saving policies.

reusability_assessment.notes: Essential reference for building fos_device_control Android Kotlin background services (S1-01 / S1-08).
